topBar.note: nav.tsx: measures every link at its natural width, sets the list's minimum to More and the kept link, and draws the menu fixed under its button

TopNav.note: one line: links that do not fit move into a More menu

NavList.note: a list of links, then the More menu, named by moreLabel

NavLink.note: count as a plain badge, its text in the tone's colour

Button.note: native button, or a link styled as one

Icon.note: Unicode glyphs instead of an icon set

Dialog.note: native <dialog> with showModal; layout and flush in theme.css

Tooltip.note: the fallback: the native title attribute
